nodes.description: uint256 public _currentIndex; counter identifying the current lottery index and used as totalSupply
uint256 public _lottoAddressCounter; secondary counter for lottery addresses
mapping(uint256 => address) counterToAddress; index-to-address registry
mapping(address => uint256) addressToCounter; address-to-index registry
mapping(uint256 => uint256) lottoPrice; ticket price per lottery index
mapping(uint256 => uint256[]) addressPool; participants pool per lottery index
mapping(uint256 => uint256) ticketsPurchased; tickets sold per lottery
mapping(uint256 => uint256) ticketsSupply; max ticket supply per lottery
mapping(uint256 => address) lottoWinner; winner address per lottery, zero means lottery open
mapping(uint256 => uint256) _mintCounter; number of tickets minted per lottery
mapping(uint256 => address) _tokenOwner; owner of each minted ticket id
TuskCoinV2 tuskCoinV2; external V2 token contract reference used for balance checks and payments
ITuskCoinV1 tusckCoinV1; external V1 token contract reference used to burn tokens
constructor(address _v1, address _v2) wires the V1 and V2 external token contracts
totalSupply() returns _currentIndex inside an unchecked block
_mintTicket(uint256 _index, address _user, uint256 _amount) internal; loops minting ticket ids to _tokenOwner using unchecked pre-increment of _mintCounter
buyTicketFromTuskCoinV2(uint64 _index, uint64 _amount) public; reads balance from V2 token then calls tuskCoinV2.pay and updates supply/owners
buyTicketFromTuskCoinV1(uint64 _index, uint64 _amount) public payable; calls tusckCoinV1.burn then updates supply and mints tickets
viewWinner(uint64 _index) returns lottoWinner[_index]
createLottery(uint64 _ticketMaxSupply, uint256 _price) onlyOwner; increments _currentIndex unchecked and seeds supply/price
setLotteryTicketPrice(uint64 _index, uint256 _price) onlyOwner; updates lottoPrice with a >0 require
drawLottery(uint64 _index) onlyOwner; picks a pseudorandom winner index and writes lottoWinner
_getRandom(uint64 _range) public view; weak randomness from keccak256(block.difficulty, block.timestamp, _range) % _range
getLotteryAddressPool(uint64 _index) view returns addressPool[_index]
msg.sender; caller address used both as payer/beneficiary in buy functions and as ticket recipient
block.timestamp; miner-influenceable value used as randomness entropy in _getRandom
tuskCoinV2.pay(msg.sender, _amount*price); external call to an arbitrary token contract before state finalization, enabling reentrancy
tusckCoinV1.burn(msg.sender, _amount*price); external call to an arbitrary token contract that can reenter
unchecked { ticketsPurchased[_index] += _amount; } in buyTicketFromTuskCoinV2 - unchecked arithmetic on uint256
unchecked { ticketsPurchased[_index] += _amount; } in buyTicketFromTuskCoinV1 - unchecked arithmetic on uint256
unchecked pre-increment ++_mintCounter[_index] inside the mint loop in _mintTicket
unchecked { uint256 newIndex = _currentIndex + 1; } in createLottery - unchecked index arithmetic
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(block.difficulty, block.timestamp, _range)) used as randomness source - predictable miner-influenced entropy
parameter _v1 of constructor (V1 token address)
parameter _v2 of constructor (V2 token address)
parameter _index (uint64) of buyTicketFromTuskCoinV2
parameter _amount (uint64) of buyTicketFromTuskCoinV2
parameter _index (uint64) of buyTicketFromTuskCoinV1
parameter _amount (uint64) of buyTicketFromTuskCoinV1
parameter _index (uint64) of viewWinner
parameter _ticketMaxSupply (uint64) of createLottery
parameter _price (uint256) of createLottery
parameter _index (uint64) of setLotteryTicketPrice
parameter _price (uint256) of setLotteryTicketPrice
parameter _index (uint64) of drawLottery
parameter _range (uint64) of _getRandom, also used as the modulo divisor
parameter _index (uint64) of getLotteryAddressPool
parameter _index (uint256) of _mintTicket
parameter _user (address) of _mintTicket, the ticket recipient
parameter _amount (uint256) of _mintTicket, number of tickets to mint
uint256 price = lottoPrice[_index] in buyTicketFromTuskCoinV2
uint256 balance = tuskCoinV2.getCombinedAccountBalance(msg.sender) in buyTicketFromTuskCoinV2
uint256 price = lottoPrice[_index] in buyTicketFromTuskCoinV1
uint256 newIndex = _currentIndex + 1 inside the unchecked block of createLottery
uint winnerIndex = _getRandom(uint64(_mintCounter[_index])) in drawLottery

edges.reason: msg.sender flows into buyTicketFromTuskCoinV2 as the paying account and ticket recipient without validation
msg.sender is passed as the _spender argument of the external tuskCoinV2.pay call
msg.sender flows into buyTicketFromTuskCoinV1 as the burned-from account
msg.sender is passed as the _from argument of the external tusckCoinV1.burn call
block.timestamp is consumed by _getRandom as entropy for the winner selection
block.timestamp feeds the keccak256 weak randomness unsafe operation
buyTicketFromTuskCoinV2 performs the external pay call before finalizing ticket state, allowing reentrancy
buyTicketFromTuskCoinV2 updates ticketsPurchased inside an unchecked block
buyTicketFromTuskCoinV1 performs the external burn call before finalizing ticket state, allowing reentrancy
buyTicketFromTuskCoinV1 updates ticketsPurchased inside an unchecked block
_mintTicket increments _mintCounter inside an unchecked loop
createLottery computes newIndex = _currentIndex + 1 inside an unchecked block
_getRandom derives its result from block.difficulty and block.timestamp, a miner-predictable source
drawLottery calls _getRandom to pick the winner from predictable entropy
drawLottery reads and writes lottoWinner[_index]
drawLottery reads _mintCounter[_index] to bound the random range
drawLottery reads _tokenOwner[winnerIndex] to determine the winner
buyTicketFromTuskCoinV2 calls _mintTicket after payment
buyTicketFromTuskCoinV1 calls _mintTicket after burn
constructor assigns tuskCoinV2 external token reference
constructor assigns tusckCoinV1 external token reference
totalSupply returns _currentIndex
_mintTicket increments _mintCounter[_index] for each minted ticket
_mintTicket writes the ticket owner into _tokenOwner

buyTicketFromTuskCoinV2 reads and increments ticketsPurchased[_index]
buyTicketFromTuskCoinV2 checks ticketsSupply[_index] to cap purchases

buyTicketFromTuskCoinV1 checks lottoWinner[_index] is still unset
buyTicketFromTuskCoinV1 reads and increments ticketsPurchased[_index]
buyTicketFromTuskCoinV1 checks ticketsSupply[_index] to cap purchases
buyTicketFromTuskCoinV1 reads lottoPrice[_index] to compute the burn amount
buyTicketFromTuskCoinV1 invokes burn on tusckCoinV1
viewWinner returns lottoWinner[_index]
createLottery reads and writes _currentIndex when creating a new lottery
createLottery writes ticketsSupply[newIndex]
createLottery writes lottoPrice[newIndex]

getLotteryAddressPool returns addressPool[_index]

normalization_plan.reason: _v1 is only used to construct the tusckCoinV1 token reference inside the constructor
_v2 is only used to construct the tuskCoinV2 token reference inside the constructor
_index is a scalar index parameter consumed immediately by buyTicketFromTuskCoinV2
_amount only parameterizes the ticket purchase logic of buyTicketFromTuskCoinV2
_index is a scalar index parameter consumed immediately by buyTicketFromTuskCoinV1
_amount only parameterizes the ticket purchase logic of buyTicketFromTuskCoinV1
_index is only used to look up lottoWinner in viewWinner
_ticketMaxSupply is only stored into ticketsSupply by createLottery
_price is only stored into lottoPrice by createLottery
_index selects the lottoPrice slot written in setLotteryTicketPrice
_price is the value written to lottoPrice in setLotteryTicketPrice
_index selects the lottery drawn in drawLottery
_range is both the entropy input and the modulo bound of _getRandom
_index only selects the addressPool entry returned by getLotteryAddressPool
_index selects which _mintCounter/_tokenOwner entries _mintTicket writes
_user is the owner address written by the _mintTicket loop
_amount bounds the unchecked mint loop in _mintTicket
price caches lottoPrice[_index] locally inside buyTicketFromTuskCoinV2
balance caches the external getCombinedAccountBalance result used by the require in buyTicketFromTuskCoinV2
price caches lottoPrice[_index] locally inside buyTicketFromTuskCoinV1
newIndex is the transient lottery id computed inside createLottery
winnerIndex is the transient random result computed inside drawLottery
